quests.sentence: The new museum wing which took three years to build now houses three main galleries a hall for local history a room for rotating exhibits and a space for childrens programs
quests.correctAnswer: The new museum wing, which took three years to build, now houses three main galleries: a hall for local history, a room for rotating exhibits, and a space for children's programs.
quests.hint: This sentence layers several rules together: a nonrestrictive clause about the wing, a colon before the list of galleries, commas between list items, and a possessive apostrophe for 'children's.'
quests.explanation: Nonrestrictive clauses take commas, a colon introduces a list that explains what came before, list items are separated by commas, and 'children's' needs an apostrophe to show possession.

quests.sentence: An employee who first noticed the accounting error received a well deserved promotion the kind of attention to detail the company had been missing for years
quests.correctAnswer: An employee who first noticed the accounting error received a well-deserved promotion—the kind of attention to detail the company had been missing for years.
quests.hint: This sentence layers three things: no commas around 'who first noticed' since it identifies which employee, a hyphen joining 'well-deserved,' and a dramatic dash introducing the final explanation.
quests.explanation: The restrictive clause needs no commas, 'well-deserved' is a hyphenated compound adjective, and the em dash sets off a strong concluding explanation.

quests.sentence: The retiring teacher told the class my own mentor always said students do not remember your lessons they remember how you made them feel
quests.correctAnswer: The retiring teacher told the class, "My own mentor always said, 'Students do not remember your lessons; they remember how you made them feel.'"
quests.hint: The teacher quotes her mentor's exact words, and inside that quote, a semicolon joins two closely related independent clauses.
quests.explanation: The inner quotation uses single quotation marks, and within it, a semicolon links two independent clauses without a conjunction.

quests.sentence: Our regional sales leaders will present updates from Denver Colorado Miami Florida and Seattle Washington these three markets outperformed every projection this quarter
quests.correctAnswer: Our regional sales leaders will present updates from Denver, Colorado; Miami, Florida; and Seattle, Washington. These three markets outperformed every projection this quarter.
quests.hint: Each city already needs a comma before its state, so semicolons separate the three full locations — then a fresh sentence begins after the list is complete.
quests.explanation: Semicolons separate list items that already contain commas; once the list ends, a period closes the sentence and a new one begins with a capital letter.

quests.sentence: I keep replaying that final call in my head the coach admitted maybe I should have called a timeout
quests.correctAnswer: "I keep replaying that final call in my head," the coach admitted. "Maybe I should have called a timeout..."
quests.hint: The coach's first thought is complete, so a period closes that sentence — but his second thought trails off unfinished at the very end.
quests.explanation: A period separates the two complete quoted sentences, and the ellipsis at the end shows the final thought trailing off, unfinished.

quests.sentence: Our renovated stadium reopened with one clear purpose to give fans a modern comfortable experience while still honoring its original charm
quests.correctAnswer: Our renovated stadium reopened with one clear purpose: to give fans a modern, comfortable experience while still honoring its original charm.
quests.hint: The colon introduces the exact purpose, and 'modern' and 'comfortable' each independently describe the experience — try 'modern and comfortable' to test whether they need a comma.
quests.explanation: A colon introduces the specific purpose that follows, and coordinate adjectives like 'modern' and 'comfortable' are separated by a comma.

quests.sentence: The clinic Dr. Torress new practice on Fifth Street now accepts patients without a referral
quests.correctAnswer: The clinic (Dr. Torres's new practice on Fifth Street) now accepts patients without a referral.
quests.hint: This whole phrase is a quick aside identifying the clinic, and 'Torres' already ends in 's,' so it still takes an apostrophe and another 's' to show possession.
quests.explanation: Parentheses set off the aside, and a singular name ending in 's' still takes an apostrophe and another 's' for possession.

quests.sentence: Patients who arrive more than fifteen minutes late may need to reschedule their blood work their consultation or their imaging appointment
quests.correctAnswer: Patients who arrive more than fifteen minutes late may need to reschedule their blood work, their consultation, or their imaging appointment.
quests.hint: The clause identifying which patients needs no commas, but the three things they might need to reschedule form a list that does.
quests.explanation: 'Who arrive more than fifteen minutes late' is restrictive and needs no commas, while the three listed items each need a comma.

quests.sentence: Her new scan revealed something the radiologist rarely sees a completely healed fracture with no long term damage at all
quests.correctAnswer: Her new scan revealed something the radiologist rarely sees—a completely healed fracture with no long-term damage at all.
quests.hint: A dramatic pause sets up the rare finding, and 'long' and 'term' work together as one describing word before 'damage.'
quests.explanation: An em dash introduces the surprising finding with emphasis, and 'long-term' is a hyphenated compound adjective before the noun it describes.

quests.sentence: The new travel advisory which was updated just this morning describes conditions at the border as calm but unpredictable
quests.correctAnswer: The new travel advisory, which was updated just this morning, describes conditions at the border as "calm but unpredictable."
quests.hint: The clause about timing just adds extra detail here, and the advisory's exact wording at the end belongs in quotation marks.
quests.explanation: The nonrestrictive clause takes commas, and quotation marks enclose the exact phrase borrowed from the advisory.

quests.sentence: Our connecting flight our only option that day was delayed by two hours consequently we missed the last shuttle to the hotel
quests.correctAnswer: Our connecting flight, our only option that day, was delayed by two hours; consequently, we missed the last shuttle to the hotel.
quests.hint: The phrase naming the flight as our only option is a nonessential aside, and 'consequently' links two independent clauses with a semicolon before it and a comma after.
quests.explanation: The appositive is set off with commas, and the semicolon and comma correctly frame the conjunctive adverb 'consequently.'

quests.sentence: We packed for every possibility a warm waterproof jacket sturdy boots and a portable charger
quests.correctAnswer: We packed for every possibility: a warm, waterproof jacket, sturdy boots, and a portable charger.
quests.hint: A colon introduces the full packing list, and 'warm' and 'waterproof' each independently describe the jacket.
quests.explanation: The colon introduces the list, and coordinate adjectives like 'warm' and 'waterproof' are separated by a comma.

quests.sentence: My father a man who rarely gave advice once told me pack light and worry less
quests.correctAnswer: My father, a man who rarely gave advice, once told me, "Pack light and worry less."
quests.hint: The phrase describing your father is a nonessential aside, and his exact words at the end belong in quotation marks.
quests.explanation: The appositive is set off with commas, and quotation marks enclose the exact words your father said.

quests.sentence: A hostel that offered the best reviews online turned out to be a run down building with no working elevator
quests.correctAnswer: A hostel that offered the best reviews online turned out to be a run-down building with no working elevator.
quests.hint: The clause identifying which hostel needs no commas, and 'run' and 'down' work together as one describing word before 'building.'
quests.explanation: 'That offered the best reviews online' is restrictive and needs no commas, and 'run-down' is a hyphenated compound adjective.

quests.sentence: The layover took us through Denver Colorado Chicago Illinois and finally New York one delay after another
quests.correctAnswer: The layover took us through Denver, Colorado; Chicago, Illinois; and finally New York—one delay after another.
quests.hint: Each city already needs a comma before its state, so semicolons separate the stops — then a dash adds one final, emphatic comment.
quests.explanation: Semicolons separate list items that already contain commas, and an em dash introduces a short, emphatic closing remark.

quests.sentence: The valedictorian who nobody expected to win delivered a speech with one central message never stop asking questions
quests.correctAnswer: The valedictorian, who nobody expected to win, delivered a speech with one central message: never stop asking questions.
quests.hint: 'The valedictorian' already refers to one specific person, so the clause about expectations just adds extra detail, and the colon introduces the exact message.
quests.explanation: Because 'the valedictorian' is already unique, the clause is nonrestrictive and needs commas; the colon then introduces the specific message that follows.

quests.sentence: Our school unveiled twelve brand new science labs the old labs had not been updated in over twenty years
quests.correctAnswer: Our school unveiled twelve brand-new science labs; the old labs had not been updated in over twenty years.
quests.hint: These describing words build on each other with no comma between them, and a semicolon then joins this to a second, closely related independent clause.
quests.explanation: 'Twelve brand-new science' are cumulative adjectives with no comma between them, and a semicolon joins the two independent clauses that follow.

quests.sentence: The principal a longtime champion of the arts program announced the auditorium will finally be renovated this summer
quests.correctAnswer: The principal, a longtime champion of the arts program, announced, "The auditorium will finally be renovated this summer."
quests.hint: The phrase describing the principal is a nonessential aside, and the exact announcement at the end belongs in quotation marks.
quests.explanation: The appositive describing the principal is set off with commas, and quotation marks enclose the principal's exact announced words.

quests.sentence: Three ingredients that make this dish special are fresh basil aged parmesan and good olive oil
quests.correctAnswer: Three ingredients that make this dish special are fresh basil, aged parmesan, and good olive oil.
quests.hint: The clause identifying which ingredients needs no commas, but the three ingredients themselves form a list that does.
quests.explanation: 'That make this dish special' is restrictive and needs no commas, while the three listed ingredients are separated by commas.

quests.sentence: Chef Ramos and Chef Bettis shared vision was simple one perfect dish rather than twenty forgettable ones
quests.correctAnswer: Chef Ramos and Chef Bettis's shared vision was simple: one perfect dish rather than twenty forgettable ones.
quests.hint: The two chefs share ONE combined vision, so the apostrophe goes only on the last name, and the colon introduces exactly what that vision was.
quests.explanation: Joint possession takes an apostrophe only on the second name, and the colon introduces the specific explanation that follows.

quests.sentence: The tasting menu ended with one unforgettable course a rich velvety chocolate torte
quests.correctAnswer: The tasting menu ended with one unforgettable course—a rich, velvety chocolate torte.
quests.hint: A dramatic pause sets up the final course, and 'rich' and 'velvety' each independently describe the torte.
quests.explanation: An em dash introduces the final course with emphasis, and coordinate adjectives like 'rich' and 'velvety' are separated by a comma.

quests.sentence: The championship game which drew a record crowd featured incredible defense clutch shooting and a buzzer beating finish
quests.correctAnswer: The championship game, which drew a record crowd, featured incredible defense, clutch shooting, and a buzzer-beating finish.
quests.hint: The clause about the crowd just adds extra detail, the three highlights form a list, and 'buzzer' and 'beating' join as one describing word.
quests.explanation: The nonrestrictive clause takes commas, the three-item list takes commas, and 'buzzer-beating' is a hyphenated compound adjective.

quests.sentence: A rookie who set the franchise scoring record struggled early in the season nevertheless he finished with the best average on the team
quests.correctAnswer: A rookie who set the franchise scoring record struggled early in the season; nevertheless, he finished with the best average on the team.
quests.hint: The clause identifying which rookie needs no commas, and 'nevertheless' links the two independent clauses with a semicolon before it and a comma after.
quests.explanation: The restrictive clause takes no commas, and the semicolon and comma correctly frame the conjunctive adverb 'nevertheless.'

quests.sentence: The post game recap called it the most dramatic finish of the entire season one nobody in the stadium will soon forget
quests.correctAnswer: The post-game recap called it "the most dramatic finish of the entire season"—one nobody in the stadium will soon forget.
quests.hint: The recap's exact words belong in quotation marks, and a dash then adds one final, emphatic thought; 'post' and 'game' also join as one word.
quests.explanation: Quotation marks enclose the recap's exact phrase, an em dash introduces the closing thought, and 'post-game' is a hyphenated compound adjective.

quests.sentence: The retiring conductor a beloved figure for three decades told the orchestra my first teacher used to say music is the space between the notes
quests.correctAnswer: The retiring conductor, a beloved figure for three decades, told the orchestra, "My first teacher used to say, 'Music is the space between the notes.'"
quests.hint: The phrase describing the conductor is a nonessential aside, and inside his quote, he repeats his own teacher's exact words in single quotation marks.
quests.explanation: The appositive is set off with commas, and the nested quotation inside his words uses single quotation marks.

quests.sentence: Their finale delivered exactly what fans wanted a loud joyful celebration of everything the show had built
quests.correctAnswer: Their finale delivered exactly what fans wanted—a loud, joyful celebration of everything the show had built.
quests.hint: A dash introduces exactly what fans wanted, and 'loud' and 'joyful' each independently describe the celebration.
quests.explanation: An em dash introduces the explanation with emphasis, and coordinate adjectives like 'loud' and 'joyful' are separated by a comma.

quests.sentence: Musicians who trained at conservatories in Vienna Austria Milan Italy and Prague Czech Republic all auditioned for the new orchestra
quests.correctAnswer: Musicians who trained at conservatories in Vienna, Austria; Milan, Italy; and Prague, Czech Republic all auditioned for the new orchestra.
quests.hint: The clause identifying which musicians needs no extra commas around it, but each city already needs a comma before its country, so semicolons separate the three locations.
quests.explanation: The restrictive clause takes no surrounding commas, while semicolons separate list items that already contain their own internal commas.

quests.sentence: This new streaming platform which launched only last month already offers three clear advantages lower prices offline downloads and ad free viewing
quests.correctAnswer: This new streaming platform, which launched only last month, already offers three clear advantages: lower prices, offline downloads, and ad-free viewing.

quests.sentence: An update that finally fixed the login bug arrived with one small bonus a redesigned home screen
quests.correctAnswer: An update that finally fixed the login bug arrived with one small bonus—a redesigned home screen.
quests.hint: The clause identifying which update needs no commas, and a dash then introduces the small extra detail at the end.
quests.explanation: The restrictive clause takes no commas, and the em dash introduces the bonus detail with emphasis.
